'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an NPC that first appears in {{Quest|A Blaze in the Dark}}. She can be found by the marketplace near the Montelli Quarters afterward.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;<nowiki>21:00</nowiki> (confirmation needed)
;One time interaction
:'''Colleen:''' Oh, hey, {{Rover}}! You're here!
:{{DIcon}} Hello, Colleen.
::{{DIcon}} Wait, Zani's here too?
:'''Zani:''' ...Is it such a surprise? What, did you think I was chained to an office chair or something?
:'''Colleen:''' Hehe, I asked Ms. Zani to lend me a hand! I mean, I've done odd jobs before, but street vending? That's new.
:'''Colleen:''' Figured I'd let Zani show me the ropes for a few days. Stocking goods, keeping track of sales, that sort of thing.
:'''Zani:''' So here I am, working part-time… on my vacation. Tch. Guess that's how it goes when you're too damn good at what you do.
:'''Rover:''' So, I take it things in the Black Alley are wrapped up?
:'''Zani:''' Yeah. The Chamber of Discipline and the Family took down Talos and everyone colluding with her.
:'''Zani:''' Turns out, the folks in the Black Alley were just stuck in the mess. Those who weren't too deep in it, like Colleen, were pardoned.
:'''Zani:''' I helped them apply for the Family's support fund and set some stalls up here. Should give them a shot at starting fresh.
:'''Colleen:''' Thanks for your help, {{Rover}}, Ms. Zani. We'll make it work!
:'''Colleen:''' Oh, almost forgot! {{Rover}}, here! I heard this fruit is imported. Consider it a little thanks for everything you've done for us.
:'''Zani:''' ..That's not a fruit. Ahem, whatever. Take it, it's the thought that counts, right?
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
:{{DIcon}} Don't mind if I do.
:'''Rover:''' Sounds like things are finally looking up.
:'''Zani:''' Maybe. But who's to say there won't be another Talos?
:'''Zani:''' Eh, whatever. If another one pops up, we'll just teach them a lesson they won't forget.
:{{DIcon}} That's the Blazing Nightwalker I know.
:{{DIcon}} Reliable as ever, Ms. Zani.
:'''Zani:''' What a shame. No matter how much you butter me up, the Vault still won't give me any extra days off...
:'''Zani:''' Wait! Can you put that in my performance review...?
;(Obtain 5 [[Pavo Plum]]]]
{{Dialogue End}}
